name: pixel-forge
description: Local AI batch image processing & export tool

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,app -c blue,green,magenta "vite" "tsx watch workers/server.ts" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.lint: eslint src electron workers scripts vite.config.ts --ext .ts,.vue,.js,.cjs,.mjs
scripts.build:web: cross-env VITE_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3847/api VITE_WORKER_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3847 vue-tsc --noEmit && cross-env VITE_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3847/api VITE_WORKER_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:3847 vite build
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run build:worker && npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs darwin arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run build:worker && npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs darwin x64 && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:worker && npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs darwin arm64 && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs darwin x64 && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run build:worker && npm run build:web && npm run prepare:win && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:worker && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
